work.description: Complete named royal address, congratulations on the daughter’s birth, blessing and closing survive. Source citation10779 is this letter’s note1 despite being emitted after the following Burmese letter. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI at LF10674–10674; the source closing at LF10713–10716 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die decima tertia iul. millesimo octingentesimo quadragesimo, pon- tificatus Nostri anno decimo..  Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
